blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Invisible watermarks are used to mark who owns a painting. We show that a simple attack removes the most robust one we test. The attack redraws the watermarked painting with brush strokes, using a pretrained stroke-based renderer. We call this attack BrushOff. It needs no training, no knowledge of the watermark, and no generative model. We test four watermarks on 500 paintings from five styles. VINE, a recent watermark built to survive image editing, survives all 14 conventional distortions we test, with at least 97.8% detection. Repainting lowers its detection to 1.8%, while the output keeps a no-reference quality score close to that of the clean paintings. Diffusion regeneration can also remove VINE, but at the same removal level it moves the image twice as far from the painting in DreamSim distance, and it changes what the painting shows. Because the renderer draws a countable number of strokes, we can control the attack strength step by step. Finally, we test what kind of signal survives. A simple probe that stores bits in the relative brightness of neighboring regions survives repainting, while a probe that uses absolute brightness does not. The same probe fails under diffusion regeneration, while VINE fails under repainting. Robustness to these two attacks is therefore a separate property, and benchmarks should test both.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Examples from three styles. JPEG and blur keep the VINE watermark but leave strong artifacts. blocks.en: Invisible watermarks are a common tool to record who owns an image. Artists, museums, and platforms can embed an owner ID into a painting before sharing it online. For this to work, the mark must survive the ways people copy and modify images.
blocks.zh: 隐形水印是记录谁拥有一幅图像的常用工具. 艺术家,博物馆,和平台可以在网络分享之前将所有者ID嵌入一幅画中. 要做到这一点,标记必须活过人们复制和修改图像的方式.

blocks.en:
Recent watermarks are robust to many changes.
VINE [ 1 ] is designed to survive not only compression and blur, but also generative editing with diffusion models.
In our tests on 500 paintings, it survives all 14 conventional distortions, including JPEG quality 5 and strong blur.
blocks.zh:
最近的水印对许多变化是强有力的。
VINE [1]的设计不仅是为了活下来的压缩和模糊,而且还是为了用扩散模型进行基因编辑.
在我们对500幅画作的测试中,它活过所有14个常规扭曲,包括JPEG质量5和强烈模糊.

blocks.en:
A painting can be copied in another way: it can be painted again.
A human copyist does not reproduce pixels.
They reproduce the composition, the colors, and the main shapes with brush strokes.
Stroke-based renderers [ 2 , 3 ] do the same thing automatically.
They describe an image with a set of strokes, each with a position, size, angle, and color.
We ask a simple question: does a watermark survive when a painting is redrawn with strokes?
blocks.zh:
画作可以被另一种方式复制:可以被再作画.
人类复制师不复制像素.
它们复制了成分,颜色,以及以刷子打出的主要形状.
基于中弦的渲染器[2,3]自动做同样的事情.
他们描述的图像有一组中风,每个都有一个位置,大小,角度,和颜色.
我们问一个简单的问题:一幅被中风所重绘的画能活下来吗?

blocks.en:
For VINE, the most robust watermark we test, the answer is no.
We redraw each watermarked painting with Paint Transformer [ 3 ] , a pretrained renderer, without any training.
We call this attack BrushOff.
VINE drops from 100% to 1.8% detection.
The repainted images keep a MUSIQ quality score of 58.2, close to 59.2 for the clean paintings, and keep the composition and subject (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
对于VINE,我们测试的最坚固的水印,答案是否定的.
我们用涂料变形器重新绘制每幅有水印的绘画 一种训练有素的渲染器
我们称这次袭击为"BrushOff".
VINE检测率从100%降至1.8%.
被再油漆的图像保留了MUSIQ质量分数58.2分,接近清版画的59.2分,并保留了组成和主题(图1.

blocks.en:
Repainting differs from the standard generative attack.
Diffusion regeneration [ 4 ] also removes watermarks, but it relies on a model that has learned what images look like.
It can replace parts of the image with new content.
Repainting has no such prior.
Each stroke copies its color from the input.
At the same removal level, diffusion regeneration moves the image twice as far from the painting in DreamSim distance (0.559 vs. 0.265), and it visibly changes the content.

Repainting also gives a scale that diffusion attacks do not have.
The number of strokes is an explicit and countable bottleneck.
We can increase it step by step and see when a watermark starts to survive.
blocks.zh:
再油漆也使扩散攻击没有规模。
中风的次数是一个明确而可数的瓶颈.
我们可以一步一步地增加它 看水印何时开始活下来

blocks.en:
Finally, we ask what kind of signal survives repainting.
We test two simple low-frequency probes.
A probe that stores bits in the relative brightness of neighboring regions survives repainting with 83% detection.
A probe that uses absolute brightness fails.
The surviving probe, however, fails under diffusion regeneration, while VINE fails under repainting.
Robustness to the two attacks is therefore a separate property.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们想问,在重新油漆过程中,什么样的信号能够幸存下来。
我们测试两个简单的低频探测器。
一个在相邻地区的相对亮度中存储比特的探测器以83%的探测率活了下来.
使用绝对亮度的探测器失败了.
然而,幸存的探测器在扩散再生过程中失败了,而VINE在再生过程中失败了.
因此,这两起袭击的有力性是一个独立财产。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We show that stroke-based repainting removes VINE, a watermark that survives all conventional distortions we test, while keeping image quality close to the clean paintings. • We compare repainting with diffusion regeneration on 500 paintings from five styles. At the same removal level, repainting changes the painting about half as much in DreamSim distance and keeps its content. • We use the stroke count as a measurable bottleneck, and show with two probes that relative brightness survives repainting while absolute brightness does not. Robustness to repainting and to regeneration are separate properties.

blocks.en: We show that stroke-based repainting removes VINE, a watermark that survives all conventional distortions we test, while keeping image quality close to the clean paintings.
blocks.zh: 我们显示中风再油漆可以消除VINE, 这个水印能活下来, 我们测试所有的常规扭曲, 同时保持图像质量接近干净的绘画。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Classical methods embed bits in a transform domain, such as DWT and DCT coefficients [ 5 , 6 ] .
Learned methods train an encoder and a decoder together, often with distortions in the training loop [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
TrustMark [ 10 ] adds error correction and works at any resolution.
VINE [ 1 ] uses a generative prior and is trained to survive image editing, including diffusion-based editing.
Other methods embed the watermark during generation, such as Stable Signature [ 11 ] , Tree-Ring [ 12 ] , and Gaussian Shading [ 13 ] .
We focus on post-hoc watermarks, because a painting already exists before it is marked.
blocks.zh:
经典方法将比特嵌入了变形域中,如DWT和DCT系数[5,6].
学习的方法一起训练一个编码器和一个解码器,经常在训练循环中出现扭曲[7,8,9].
TrustMark [10] 添加了错误更正,并在任何解析中有效.
VINE [1] 使用先基因后基因,并经过培训后能活过图像编辑,包括基于扩散的编辑.
其他方法也嵌入了生成时的水印,如"稳定签名"[11],"树-亮"[12],"高斯沙丁"[13].
我们专注于后热水标记,因为一幅画在被标记之前就已经存在了.

blocks.en:
The standard removal attacks are conventional distortions and regeneration.
Zhao et al. [ 4 ] show that pixel-level watermarks can be removed by encoding an image into a generative model and decoding it back.
Benchmarks such as WAVES [ 14 ] and W-Bench [ 1 ] test watermarks against distortions, regeneration, and image editing.
Recent work uses diffusion-based image editing to remove or launder watermarks [ 15 ] .
All of these attacks rely on a learned generative prior.
Our attack does not.
This lets us separate removal by re-rendering from removal by a learned prior.
blocks.zh:
标准的去除攻击是传统的扭曲和再生.
赵等. [4] 显示像素级水印可以通过将一幅图像编码入基因模型并解码回取出.
WAVES [14]和W-Bench [1] 等基准测试水印防止扭曲、再生和图像编辑。
最近的工作使用以传播为基础的图像编辑来去除或清洗水印[15].
所有这些攻击都依赖于先入为主的知识。
我们的攻击不是。
这使得我们通过重新交接与被学过的人的取走而分开.

blocks.en:
Several works watermark artworks or protect artistic style [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
Adversarial protections such as Glaze [ 19 ] can be removed by simple steps such as noisy upscaling [ 20 ] .
We study a different target: invisible marks that record ownership.
blocks.zh:
若干作品有水印画或保护艺术风格[16、17、18]。
Glaze [19]等反面保护可以通过吵闹的提升等简单步骤去除[20].
我们研究的是另一个目标: 记录所有权的无形标记。

blocks.en:
Stroke-based renderers describe an image with a sequence of brush strokes.
Learning to Paint [ 2 ] uses reinforcement learning.
Paint Transformer [ 3 ] predicts strokes in one pass with a transformer and paints from coarse to fine.
Later work predicts where to paint at each step [ 21 ] .
StegoNPR [ 22 ] hides data in the arrangement of non-photorealistic strokes.
That work embeds data through strokes.
We use strokes to remove data.
To our knowledge, stroke-based rendering has not been studied as a watermark removal attack.
blocks.zh:
基于中弦的渲染器描述出一幅带有一串笔划的图像.
学习到绘画[2]采用强化学习.
绘图变形器 [3] 预言一通用变压器打出中风,从粗到细的涂料.
后来的作品预测了每一步的绘画地点[21].
StegoNPR [22] 将数据隐藏在非现实主义中风的安排中.
工作通过中风将数据嵌入。
我们用中风删除数据。
据我们所知,中风的渲染没有被作为去除水印的攻击来研究.

blocks.en: III Threat Model and Repainting Attack
blocks.zh: 三. 威胁模式和再油漆攻击

blocks.en: III-A Threat model
blocks.zh: 三-A威胁模式

blocks.en:
We consider an attacker who wants to remove the provenance mark from a painting.
The attacker has one watermarked image, does not know the method, key, or payload, cannot query the detector, and does not train any model.
A typical case: a painting is shared online with an invisible owner mark, and someone downloads it, re-renders it, and posts the result as their own.
blocks.zh:
我们认为攻击者想从一幅画上取出出处的标记.
攻击者有一个水印图像,不知道方法,密钥或有效载荷,无法查询探测器,也不训练出任何模型.
典型案例:一幅画被网上分享,有隐形的主人标识,有人下载,重新发售,并贴出结果为自己.

blocks.en:
The attack succeeds if two conditions hold.
First, the detector no longer finds the watermark at a fixed false positive rate.
Second, the output still looks like the same painting, like a copy made by hand.
We therefore always report detection together with fidelity (Sec. IV-E ).
blocks.zh:
如果具备两个条件,攻击就会成功。
首先,探测器不再以固定的假正率找到水印.
第二,产出仍然像同一幅画,就像手抄本.
因此,我们总是报告检测与忠诚(第IV-E条)。

blocks.en: III-B Repainting with a stroke-based renderer
blocks.zh: 三-B 用中风制发器再油漆

blocks.en:
Our attack redraws the watermarked image with brush strokes.
We use Paint Transformer [ 3 ] , a pretrained stroke-based renderer.
We use the released model as is, without any training or tuning.
blocks.zh:
我们的攻击用笔划重画出水印图像
我们使用涂料变形器 [3], 一个训练有素的中风成形器。
我们按原样使用释放的模型,不用任何训练或调音.

blocks.en:
Paint Transformer paints from coarse to fine.
At layer k k , it resizes the target image to 32 ⋅ 2 k 32\cdot 2^{k} pixels per side and splits it into 32 × 32 32\times 32 patches.
For each patch, the network looks at the target and the current canvas, and predicts 8 strokes.
Each stroke has five shape parameters (center x , y x,y , width, height, angle) and one RGB color.
The color is sampled from the target image at the stroke center.
A binary decision per stroke controls whether it is drawn.
For a canvas of size S S , there are K + 1 K+1 layers with K = ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( S / 32 ) ⌉ K=\lceil\log_{2}(S/32)\rceil .
After the last layer, the official code adds one border pass.
This pass shifts the patch grid by half a patch to cover the seams between patches.

画变形器 从粗到细.
在图层 k k 上, 它将目标图像大小 : 32 \\ k 32\ cdot 2\ k} 每边像素并分出为32×32相32相32相32相的补丁.
对于每个补丁,网络查看目标和当前画布,并预测出8个中风.
每个中风有5个外形参数(中点x,y,y,宽度,高度,角度)和1个RGB颜色.
颜色取自中风中心的目标图像.
每个中风的二进制决定控制它是否被绘制.
对于尺寸为 S S 的画布,有 K + 1 K + 1 层,有 K = + log 2 → (S / 32 ) → K → lceil\log → 2} (S/32)\rceil 。
在上一层之后,官方代码会增加一条边界通关.
这个通路将补丁网格换了半个补丁来覆盖补丁之间的接合.

blocks.en:
We save the canvas after every layer.
This gives a sequence of outputs from one painting run, which we call stroke levels.
Level L ℓ \ell for ℓ ≤ K + 1 \ell\leq K+1 is the canvas after layer ℓ − 1 \ell-1 .
The last level, L ( K + 2 ) (K+2) , adds the border pass and equals the official output.
One run therefore gives all levels at no extra cost.
blocks.zh:
我们每层都保存画布
这给出了一幅画的系列输出, 我们称之为中风水平。
L级 l\ell 用于 l + K + 1\ ell\ leq K+1 是相接的相接相接相接相接的相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 。
最后一个关卡L (K + 2 (K + 2) (K + 2)),会增加出界口并等同官方输出.
因此,一跑可以不增加任何费用地给予所有级别。

blocks.en:
The border pass draws all of its strokes.
In the official code, the stroke decision in this pass is not binarized, so every predicted stroke is drawn.
We keep this behavior so that our last level matches the official output.
As a result, the last level has many more strokes than the level before it.
For this reason we use the number of strokes actually drawn, not the level index, when we study how detection depends on the attack strength (Sec. V-C ).
blocks.zh:
出界道所取所取所取所取所取相.
在官方代码中,此传中中风决定没有被二进制,因此每个预言中风都是被划出来.
我们保持这一行为 这样我们最后一个关卡 匹配官方输出。
因此,上一关的中风比前一关多出很多.
为此,当研究检测如何取决于攻击强度(Sec. V-C.)时,我们使用实际所绘制的中风次数,而不是水平指数.

blocks.en:
We control stroke size by changing the canvas size.
For canvas size S ∈ { 1024 , 2048 } S\in\{1024,2048\} , we upsample the 512 × 512 512\times 512 input with bicubic interpolation, paint it, and downsample the result back to 512 × 512 512\times 512 with antialiasing.
A larger canvas adds more layers, so strokes become smaller relative to the image.
The 512 512 , 1024 1024 , and 2048 2048 canvases give 6, 7, and 8 levels.
We denote a setting by canvas size and level, for example RP-2048/L6.
III-C Why repainting removes watermarks
blocks.zh: III-C 为什么重新油漆会去掉水印

blocks.en:
Repainting replaces every pixel with strokes.
The output is a function of the stroke parameters only.
Any signal that the strokes do not capture is lost.
blocks.zh:
重新油漆用中风来取代每个像素.
输出只是中风参数的一个函数.
中风没有捕捉到的任何信号都丢失了.

blocks.en:
The strokes form an explicit and countable bottleneck.
Each drawn stroke carries 8 numbers.
At RP-2048/L6, the renderer draws about 6,000 strokes per image, or about 48,000 numbers.
A 512 × 512 512\times 512 RGB image has 786,432 786{,}432 values.
So the painting is described with about 6% of the original values.
We can increase this budget step by step by moving to finer levels.
This lets us plot watermark survival against the number of strokes (Sec. V-C ).
Diffusion-based attacks do not offer such a scale, because their latent space is not easy to interpret.
blocks.zh:
中风形成一个明确而可数的瓶颈.
每次中风都带8个号码
在RP-2048/L6上,渲染器绘制出每幅图像约6000个中风,即约48000个数字.
512×512 512\times 512 RGB图像有786,432 786{,}432个值.
因此画作以约6%的原始价值来描述.
我们可以逐步增加这一预算,使预算更精确。
这让我们能根据中风的数量(中风V-C)来绘制水印活命图.
以扩散为基础的攻击不能提供这种规模,因为其潜在的空间不容易解释。

blocks.en:
Paint Transformer has no generative prior over natural images.
It does not invent content.
Each stroke copies its color from the input at one location.
This separates two possible reasons for watermark removal.
Diffusion regeneration may remove a watermark because the model replaces image content with what it has learned.
Repainting can only remove a watermark by re-rendering the existing content.
If a watermark survives diffusion regeneration but not repainting, its weakness is the rendering itself, not a learned prior.
blocks.zh:
涂料变形器没有先于自然图像的基因.
它不发明内容。
每个中风从一个位置的输入复制其颜色.
这分离出水印去除的两个可能的原因.
扩散再生可能去掉一个水印,因为模型用它学到的东西来取代图像内容.
重新油漆只能通过重报现有内容来去除水印.
如果一个水印能活下来扩散再生但不能再油漆,那么它的弱点就是渲染本身,而不是先入为主。

blocks.en: The attack is cheap: about 27 s per image at canvas size 2048 on one consumer GPU, with no training.
blocks.zh: 攻击价格低廉:以2048号帆布大小每幅图像约27 s在一个消费者GPU上,没有训练.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Data
blocks.zh: 数据

blocks.en:
We use 500 paintings from WikiArt [ 23 ] , 100 from each of five styles: Baroque, Impressionism, Pointillism, Ukiyo-e, and Color Field Painting.
We chose these styles because they differ in texture.
Baroque paintings have smooth gradients and fine detail.
Impressionism and Pointillism are made of visible brush marks and dots.
Ukiyo-e prints have flat colors and sharp outlines.
Color Field paintings have large flat regions with little texture.
We sample images at random with a fixed seed, keep those with a short side of at least 512 pixels, center-crop them to a square, and resize them to 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
The WikiArt data is used for non-commercial research only.
blocks.zh:
我们使用从维基艺术[23]出道的500幅画作,每幅有100幅:巴洛克,印象主义,Pointillism,Ukiyo-e,和彩色地画.
我们之所以选择这些风格,是因为其纹理不同.
巴洛克画有平滑的梯度和细微的细节.
印象主义和"尖端"(Pointillism)由明显的刷分和点来制作.
Ukiyo-e指纹有平平的颜色和尖锐的轮廓.
彩地画有较大的平地区域,纹理很少.
我们随机抽取有固定种子的图像,保留有短边至少512像素的图像,中间将图像打成正方形,并调整大小为512×512 512\times 512.
维基文库中的相关数据仅用于非商业性研究.

blocks.en: IV-B Watermarks
blocks.zh: 四-B 水印

blocks.en:
We evaluate four post-hoc watermarks.
VINE [ 1 ] is a recent learned watermark designed to survive image editing, including generative editing.
We use the released VINE-R model with a 100-bit payload.
TrustMark [ 10 ] is a learned watermark with error correction.
We use the Q model with a 61-bit payload and the default BCH code, which gives 100 bits in total.
RivaGAN [ 9 ] is a learned watermark with a 32-bit payload.
DwtDctSvd is a classical frequency-domain method with a 32-bit payload.
For RivaGAN and DwtDctSvd we use the invisible-watermark library [ 6 ] .
Every image carries the same fixed payload.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了四个水印
VINE [1] 是一款最近学来的水印,旨在活过图像编辑,包括基因编辑.
我们使用释放出带有100位有效载荷的VINE-R型.
TrustMark [10] 是一个学习过的水印并有错误修正.
我们使用有61位有效载荷和默认BCH代码的Q模型,总共给出了100位.
RivaGAN [9]是一个有32位有效载荷的有学识的水印.
DwtDctSvd是一种具有32位有效载荷的古典频域方法.
对于RivaGAN和DwtDctSvd,我们使用隐形-水印库[6].
每一个图像都带有相同的固定有效载荷.

blocks.en:
We also tested DwtDct from the same library.
It fails on 151 of the 500 paintings before any attack, and on 44 of the 100 Color Field paintings.
We report it in Table I but leave it out of the attack evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们还从同一个图书馆测试了DwtDct.
它在任何攻击前的500幅画有151幅失败,100幅彩地画有44幅失败.
我们把它在表一中报告,但把它排除在攻击评估之外。

blocks.en:
Table I reports embedding quality.
All four methods reach a mean PSNR above 36 dB.
VINE has the lowest PSNR (36.9 dB) and TrustMark the highest (42.4 dB).
blocks.zh:
表一报告嵌入质量。
所有四种方法都达到平均PSNR高于36分贝.
VINE拥有最低的PSNR(36.9 dB)和最高的TrustMark(42.4 dB).

blocks.en: TABLE I: Embedding quality on 500 paintings. PSNR: mean / min. Det.: detected right after embedding. FP: detections on the 500 clean paintings.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:将品质嵌入500幅画上. PSNR:表示/分钟. Det.:嵌入后检测到的. FP:500幅清真画上的探测.

blocks.en: IV-C Detection
blocks.zh: 四-C 检测

blocks.en:
We decide detection at a fixed false positive rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
For a payload of n n bits, we assume that the decoded bits of an unwatermarked image are independent and uniform.
We then pick the smallest bit accuracy τ \tau such that the chance of reaching τ \tau by luck is at most 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
This gives τ = 26 / 32 \tau=26/32 for RivaGAN and DwtDctSvd, and τ = 66 / 100 \tau=66/100 for VINE.
For TrustMark we use its own decision: the watermark is detected if error correction succeeds and recovers the payload exactly.
blocks.zh:
我们以10 - 3 10 - 3的固定假阳性率决定检测。
对于n n bits的有效载荷,我们假设一个无水标记图像的解码比特是独立而统一的.
然后我们选择最小的位精度 \ tau , 这样幸运到达\ tau 的机会最多为 10 - 3 10 - 3 。
这使RivaGAN和DwtDctSvd得到 26. 32\tau=26/32,VINE得到66/100\tau=66/100。
用于信任 标记我们使用它自己的决定:如果错误修正成功并精确地回收了有效载荷,就会被检测出水印.

blocks.en:
We check the false positive rate empirically.
We run every detector on the 500 clean paintings.
None of them fires on any clean painting.
blocks.zh:
我们实证地检查假正率
我们运行每一个探测器 在500个干净的画。
没有一个在任何干净的画上放火.

blocks.en:
We also check each watermark right after embedding.
An image that is not detected before any attack cannot tell us anything about the attack.
We drop such images for that watermark and report them separately.
This affects only RivaGAN, which fails on 15 of 500 paintings before any attack.
Fourteen of them are Color Field paintings, which have large flat regions and little texture to hide a signal in.
blocks.zh:
我们还在嵌入后检查每个水印。
在任何攻击发生前没有发现的图像不能告诉我们任何关于攻击的信息。
我们把水印的图像丢掉 单独报告
这只影响到了RivaGAN,在任何攻击之前,500幅画中有15幅失败了。
其中14幅是彩地画作,这些画作有较大的平地区和很少的纹理来隐藏一个信号.

blocks.en: IV-D Attacks
blocks.zh: 四-D 攻击

blocks.en:
We run the repainting attack of Sec. III-B with canvas sizes 512, 1024, and 2048.
This gives 21 settings, from RP-512/L1 to RP-2048/L8.
For VINE, we run all settings on all 500 paintings.
Canvas size 2048 is slow (Sec. III-C ).
For the other three watermarks, we therefore run it on a subset of 100 paintings, the first 20 of each style.
blocks.zh:
我们用512、1024和2048号帆布 进行三号B的再油漆攻击
这给出了21个设置,从RP-512/L1到RP-2048/L8.
对于VINE,我们运行所有设置 所有500幅画。
Canvas大小为2048,速度缓慢(Sec. III-C.).
对于其他三个水印,我们因此运行在由100幅绘画组成的子集上,每种风格的前20幅.

blocks.en:
We compare against diffusion regeneration [ 4 ] , the standard generative removal attack.
The image is encoded with the Stable Diffusion VAE, noised to a given strength, and denoised back.
We use Stable Diffusion 2.1-base [ 24 ] in image-to-image mode with an empty prompt, no classifier-free guidance, 50 denoising steps, and a fixed seed.
We test strengths 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.5 on all four watermarks.
Strength 0 is a VAE round trip without noise.
For VINE, we add strengths 0.6, 0.7, and 0.8, because VINE still survives at 0.5.
We denote a setting by its strength, for example Regen-0.5.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了扩散再生[4], 标准基因清除攻击。
图像被用"稳定分化VAE"编码,被点出给定强度,并去除回音.
我们使用稳定分化2.1-基 [24] 在图像到图像模式中,一个空的即时,没有无分级的引导,50个去诺化步骤,以及一个固定的种子.
我们测试优势0,0.1,0.2,0.3,并测试所有四个水印.
强0是无噪声的VAE回程.
对于VINE,我们加入了优势0.6,0.7和0.8,因为VINE仍然活到0.5.
我们用它的强度来表示一个环境,例如Regen-0.5。

blocks.en: IV-E Fidelity metrics
blocks.zh: 四-E 菲德尔度量标准

blocks.en:
We measure how close the attacked image stays to the clean painting.
All metrics compare against the clean painting, not the watermarked one.
We use three metrics, because no single one captures what we need.
blocks.zh:
我们测量被攻击的图像与干净的画的距离。
所有度量衡都与干净的画作相比,而不是水印画.
我们使用三个标准,因为没有人能捕捉到我们需要的东西。

blocks.en:
DISTS [ 25 ] measures structure and texture similarity.
DreamSim [ 26 ] measures perceptual similarity at a higher level, closer to whether two images show the same thing.
For both, lower means closer to the clean painting.
MUSIQ [ 27 ] is a no-reference quality score.
It measures whether an image looks free of artifacts such as blur, noise, and block patterns.
Higher is better.
The clean paintings have a mean MUSIQ of 59.2.
We also report PSNR for reference.
blocks.zh:
DISTS [25] 测量结构和纹理相似.
DreamSim [26] 测量更高层次的知觉相似性,更接近两个图像是否显示相同的东西.
对两者来说,更低就意味着更接近于干净的画作.
MUSIQ [27] 是无参考质量分数.
它测量一个图像看起来是否没有诸如模糊,噪音,和块状图案等文物.
高点更好
干净的画作有59. 2的平面MUSIQ.
我们还报告PSNR供参考。

blocks.en:
MUSIQ does not check whether the content matches the painting: a coarse repainting with a few hundred strokes can score high.
We therefore always read MUSIQ together with DreamSim.
blocks.zh:
MUSIQ不检查内容是否与油画相匹配:粗糙再油漆后打出几百下打分就可以得分高.
因此,我们总是阅读MUSIQ和DreamSim。

blocks.en:
In a pilot study, fidelity barely depended on which watermark the image carried.
We therefore compute fidelity on the VINE images and use it for all methods.
blocks.zh:
在一项试点研究中,忠诚度几乎不取决于图像所携带的水印。
因此,我们计算VINE图像的忠诚度,并用于所有方法。

blocks.en:
We report 95% confidence intervals for detection rates.
We compute them with a bootstrap over images, using 2,000 resamples and the percentile method.
blocks.zh:
我们报告95%的置信间隔检测率。
用两千个复标和百分位法来计算它们。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: Table II gives the main numbers.
blocks.zh: 表二列出主要数字。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Fidelity and detection under each attack. Fidelity is measured against the clean painting. The clean paintings have a mean MUSIQ of 59.2. Detection rates use a fixed false positive rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . † : 100-image subset. –: not run.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:在每次攻击下,都具有可贵性和侦测性。 菲德尔是用干净的画来衡量的。 干净的画作有59. 2的平面MUSIQ. 检测率使用固定的假正率为10 — 3 10 — 3} 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: V-A Repainting removes VINE
blocks.zh: V- A 重漆去除 VINE

blocks.en:
VINE survives every conventional distortion we test.
Its detection rate stays at or above 97.8% under all 14 distortions, including JPEG quality 5 and blur radius 8 (Table II ).
These two distortions are already strong.
JPEG q5 drops MUSIQ from 59.2 to 32.3, and blur radius 8 drops it to 15.1.
blocks.zh:
VINE能活下来 我们测试的每一个传统扭曲。
其检测率在所有14个扭曲下保持在或高于97.8%,包括JPEG质量5和模糊半径8(表二)。
这两个扭曲已经很强烈。
JPEG q5将MUSIQ从59.2降至32.3,模糊半径8将其降至15.1.

blocks.en:
Repainting removes VINE.
At RP-2048/L6, the detection rate drops to 1.8% (95% CI: 0.8–3.2%).
At RP-1024/L6, it drops to 3.0%.
blocks.zh:
重新油漆可以删除 VINE.
在RP-2048/L6中,检测率降至1.8%(95%CI:0.8-3.2%)。
在RP-1024/L6时,降为3.0%.

blocks.en:
The repainted images still look like normal paintings.
RP-2048/L6 keeps a MUSIQ of 58.2, close to the 59.2 of the clean paintings.
Its DreamSim to the clean painting is 0.265.
This is close to JPEG q5 (0.230) and lower than blur radius 8 (0.355).
In other words, at a similar perceptual distance, JPEG and blur leave visible artifacts and keep the watermark, while repainting gives a clean-looking image and removes the watermark.
Fig. 2 shows this for all settings.
Fig. 1 shows examples.
blocks.zh:
被再油漆的图像仍然像普通的绘画.
RP-2048/L6保持了58.2的MUSIQ,接近于清代画作的59.2.
它的"梦幻"(DreamSim)到"干净"的画作为0.265.
这接近JPEG q5(0.230)并低于模糊半径8(0.355).
换句话说,在相近的感知距离上,JPEG和模糊地留下了可见的文物并保留了水印;而再油漆则给出了一副清澈的外观并去除了水印.
图2显示所有设置。
图1显示了实例。

blocks.en:
Coarser levels remove all watermarks but change the painting too much.
At levels L1 to L5, no watermark is detected in more than 6% of images at any canvas size.
But DreamSim is above 0.35 at these levels, and the images lose much of their detail.
We therefore focus on L6 and finer levels.
blocks.zh:
相干级去掉所有水印,但改变画太多.
在L1到L5的级别上,在任何画布大小的超过6%的图像中都没有检测出水印.
但DreamSim在这些级别上高于0.35,而画面也损失了大部分细节.
因此,我们把重点放在L6和更精细的水平上。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: (a) VINE detection rate and (b) MUSIQ against DreamSim distance to the clean painting. Each curve is one attack family at increasing strength. Error bars: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Dotted line in (b): mean MUSIQ of the clean paintings.
blocks.zh: 图2: (a) VINE检测率和(b) MUSIQ 对抗 DreamSim 与清洁画的距离. 每个曲线都是一个攻击家族,强度不断提高. 出错行: 95% 的靴子置信间隔 。 (b)中被点缀的行:指清洁画的MUSIQ.

blocks.en: V-B Comparison with diffusion regeneration
blocks.zh: V-B 与传播再生的比较

blocks.en:
Diffusion regeneration can also remove VINE, but it needs to change the image much more.
At strength 0.5, VINE is still detected in 47.4% of images (95% CI: 42.8–51.8%).
Detection only falls to 1.8%, the level reached by RP-2048/L6, at strength 0.8.
blocks.zh:
分泌再生也可以去除VINE,但需要多多地改变图像.
在强度为0.5时,47.4%的图像仍然检测出VINE(95% CI:42.8–51.8%).
检测率仅降至1.8%,为RP-2048/L6所达到的水平,强度为0.8.

blocks.en:
At the same removal level, repainting stays closer to the painting.
Regen-0.8 has a DreamSim of 0.559, while RP-2048/L6 has 0.265.
Its PSNR is 14.4 dB, while RP-2048/L6 has 19.9 dB.
DISTS is similar for the two (0.325 and 0.349).
blocks.zh:
在同一取出水平上,再油漆保持更接近油画.
Regen-08的DreamSim为0.559,而RP-2048/L6为0.265.
其PSNR为14.4分贝,而RP-2048/L6有19.9分贝.
二者(0.325和0.349)的DISTS相似.

blocks.en:
At a similar DreamSim, repainting removes far more.
Regen-0.5 and RP-2048/L6 have almost the same DreamSim (0.256 and 0.265) and MUSIQ (59.1 and 58.2).
VINE is detected in 47.4% of images after Regen-0.5, but in only 1.8% after RP-2048/L6.
blocks.zh:
在类似的 DreamSim 上,再油漆会移除更多.
Regen-0.5和RP-2048/L6具有几乎相同的DreamSim(0.256和0.265)和MUSIQ(59.1和58.2).
在Regen-0.5后47.4%的图像中检测出VINE,但在RP-2048/L6后仅检测到1.8%.

blocks.en:
Diffusion regeneration also changes what the painting shows.
In Fig. 1 , Regen-0.5 turns the dragon in the Ukiyo-e print and the bush in the Pointillist painting into different shapes, while VINE is still detected.
Repainting keeps the composition and the subject, while VINE is gone.
blocks.zh:
分泌再生也会改变画中显示的内容.
在图一中,Regen-0.5将Ukiyo-e印相中的龙和尖岩画中的灌木转化为不同的形状,而VINE仍然被检测出.
重新油漆保留了组成和主体,而VINE则已消失.

blocks.en:
MUSIQ does not penalize this change.
The MUSIQ of diffusion regeneration rises with strength, from 58.2 at strength 0 to 63.2 at 0.8.
The model adds sharp details that were not in the painting, and MUSIQ rewards them.
This is why we read MUSIQ together with DreamSim.
blocks.zh:
MUSIQ不惩罚这种变化。
扩散再生的MUSIQ随强度而上升,从0级的58.2升至0.8级的63.2.
该型号增加了画中没有的尖锐细节,而MUSIQ则奖励了他们.
这就是为什么我们阅读 MUSIQ 和 DreamSim。

blocks.en:
We see a simple reason for this result.
VINE is trained to survive generative editing [ 1 ] , so diffusion regeneration is close to what it was built for.
Repainting has no generative prior and renders the image in a different way.
VINE was not trained for this kind of change.
blocks.zh:
我们认为这一结果只有一个原因。
VINE被训练出能活过基因编辑[1],因此扩散再生接近它所建造的.
重新油漆没有先入为主,使图像具有不同的方式。
VINE没有接受过这种改变的培训。

blocks.en: V-C Detection and the number of strokes
blocks.zh: V-C 检测和中风次数

blocks.en:
For the three weaker watermarks, detection follows the number of strokes.
Fig. 3 plots detection against the number of strokes drawn.
For RivaGAN and DwtDctSvd, the curves from the three canvas sizes almost overlap.
Detection rises only after a few thousand strokes.
TrustMark stays near zero at every level.
blocks.zh:
对于三个较弱的水印,检测跟随中风的次数.
3个地块检测出中风次数
对于RivaGAN和DwtDctSvd,从三个画布大小的曲线几乎相重叠.
侦取出后才起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起
信任马克在每个级别都保持接近0.

blocks.en:
VINE shows a sharp transition.
It is detected in at most 0.2% of images at about 1,900 strokes or fewer (L5 at every canvas size).
It is detected in 62% of images at about 16,000 strokes (RP-2048/L7), and in all images at about 50,000 strokes (RP-2048/L8). So more strokes is not always better for the attacker: the best setting is the finest level that still removes the watermark, here RP-2048/L6.
blocks.zh:
VINE显示的是一个急剧的转变.
在大约1,900个或更少的图像(每张画布大小为L5)中,检测到的最多为0.2%。
在62%的图像中检测出约16 000起中风(RP-2048/L7),在所有图像中检测出约50 000起中风(RP-2048/L8)。 所以更多的中风对攻击者来说并不总是更好的:最好的设定是仍然能移除水印的最佳水平,这里是RP-2048/L6.

blocks.en:
For VINE, the stroke count is not the whole story.
RP-512/L6 draws about 4,200 strokes, fewer than RP-2048/L6 with about 6,000.
Yet VINE is detected in 53% of images after RP-512/L6, and in only 1.8% after RP-2048/L6.
Likewise, RP-1024/L7 and RP-2048/L7 draw a similar number of strokes (14,800 and 16,400), but give 96% and 62%.
In both pairs, the setting with the larger canvas, and therefore smaller strokes, removes more.
Both RP-512/L6 and RP-1024/L7 are last levels, where the border pass draws all of its strokes (Sec. III-B ).
So the size and placement of strokes also matter, not only their number.
blocks.zh:
对于VINE来说,中风计数并不是整个故事.
RP-512/L6抽取了约4200个中风,比RP-2048/L6少了约6000个.
然而,在RP-512/L6后53%的图像中检测出VINE,在RP-2048/L6后只有1.8%.
同样,RP-1024/L7和RP-2048/L7也绘制出相类似的中风(14,800和16,400),但给出了96%和62%.
在两对中,用更大的画布设置,从而去除更小的中风.
RP-512/L6和RP-1024/L7都是最后一个关卡,其中出界口取出其所有中风(Sec. III-B.
因此中风的大小和位置也很重要,不仅仅是它们的数量.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Detection rate against the number of strokes drawn, for each watermark and canvas size. Hollow markers: last level, where the border pass draws all of its strokes. Shaded bands: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. TrustMark, RivaGAN, and DwtDctSvd at canvas size 2048 use a 100-image subset.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个水印和帆布大小取出中风次数的检测率。 洞口道标:上一级,即出界取出其出界所取出之所取所取出之所取出. 被遮蔽的带:95%的靴子置信间隔. TrustMark,RivaGAN,和画布大小为2048的 DwtDctSvd 使用一个100映像子集.

blocks.en: V-D Differences between styles
blocks.zh: V-D 样式之间的差异

blocks.en:
At RP-2048/L6, repainting removes VINE in every style.
The detection rate is at most 7% in each of the five styles.
blocks.zh:
在RP-2048/L6,再油漆移除了各种风格的VINE.
探测率在五种样式中每种最多为7%.

blocks.en:
At the next level, styles differ.
At RP-2048/L7, VINE is detected in 40% of Color Field paintings and in 87% of Pointillist paintings.
The other three styles fall between 55% and 65%.
blocks.zh:
在下一级,风格不同.
在RP-2048/L7中,在40%的彩地画和87%的尖岩画中检测出VINE.
其余三种风格的跌幅为55%至65%.

blocks.en:
Diffusion regeneration shows a different pattern.
At Regen-0.5, VINE survives best on Color Field (70%) and Baroque (67%), and worst on Ukiyo-e (30%) and Impressionism (29%).
blocks.zh:
分泌再生呈现出不同的模式.
在Regen-0.5,VINE在彩色球场(70%)和巴洛克(67%)上活得最好,在Ukiyo-e(30%)和印象主义(29%)上活得最差.

blocks.en: V-E The weaker watermarks
blocks.zh: 维-欧 较弱的水印

blocks.en:
Repainting changes the robustness ranking of the weaker watermarks.
TrustMark survives blur radius 4 (95%) and down-scaling to 0.125 (83%), but every repainting setting removes it.
Even at RP-2048/L8, its detection rate is 3%.
RivaGAN behaves the other way.
It fails under blur radius 8 (0%), but survives the finest repainting (85% at RP-2048/L8).
Robustness to conventional distortions therefore does not predict robustness to repainting.
blocks.zh:
再油漆改变了弱水印的稳健性排名.
TrustMark存活了模糊半径4(95%)并缩小到0.125(83%),但每次再油漆设置都会移除.
即使在RP-2048/L8,它的检测率为3%.
RivaGAN的行为相反。
它在模糊半径8 (0%)下失效,但存活了最好的再油漆(85%在RP-2048/L8).
因此,对传统扭曲的强烈性无法预测再油漆的强烈性。

blocks.en:
For these three watermarks, repainting is not the cheapest attack.
JPEG q10 removes all three at a DreamSim of 0.111.
Regen-0.1 lowers all three to at most 9% at a DreamSim of 0.061.
Even a VAE round trip without noise (Regen-0) lowers RivaGAN to 32%.
For RivaGAN and DwtDctSvd, repainting reaches similar removal only at the coarse levels, where DreamSim is above 0.35.
TrustMark is the exception: every repainting setting removes it, down to a DreamSim of 0.116.
The advantage of repainting is specific to VINE, the watermark built to resist generative editing.
blocks.zh:
对于这三个水印来说,再油漆并不是最便宜的攻击.
JPEG q10 以 0.11 的 DreamSim 来删除全部三个.
Regen-0.1在0.061的DreamSim上将所有3个降为最多为9%.
即使是无噪声的VAE回程(Regen-0),将RivaGAN降为32%.
对RivaGAN和DwtDctSvd来说,再油漆只在粗度水平上达到相类似的去除,而DreamSim则高于0.35.
TrustMark是例外:每次再油漆设置都会将其取出,下至"梦幻Sim"0.116.
重新油漆的优点是VINE所特有的,即为抵制基因编辑而建造的水印.

blocks.en: VI What Survives Repainting?
blocks.zh: 六. 什么活下来的再油漆?

blocks.en:
Repainting keeps the composition of a painting: where things are, and which areas are lighter or darker.
If a watermark is carried by this coarse structure, it may survive.
We test this idea with two simple low-frequency probes.
The probes are not new watermarking methods.
They are textbook schemes that we use only to test the idea.
blocks.zh:
再油漆保持了一幅画的构成:事物在哪里,以及哪个区域更轻或更暗.
如果水印被这种粗糙的结构所携带,它可能会活下来.
我们用两个简单的低频探测器测试这个想法.
探测器并不是新的水标记方法。
这些是教科书计划 我们用来测试这个想法。

blocks.en: VI-A Two probes
blocks.zh: 六. A 两个探测器

blocks.en:
Both probes split the image into a G × G G\times G grid of blocks and change only the mean brightness of each block.
The change is added through a smooth Hann window inside each block, so no block edges appear.
The same change is added to R, G, and B, so only brightness changes.
Both probes carry the same 32-bit payload, repeated over the blocks with a keyed permutation.
We use the same detection threshold as for the other 32-bit methods ( 26 / 32 26/32 ).
blocks.zh:
两个探测器将图像分割成 G × G\ Times G区块网格,只改变每个区块的平均亮度.
变化通过每个块内平滑的汉恩窗口来加入,所以没有块边缘出现.
同样的变化被加入到"R","G"和"B"中,因此只有亮度变化.
这两种探测器都携带着相同的32位有效载荷,在被键接通的地块上重复.
我们使用与其他32位方法相同的检测阈值(26/32 26.32.

blocks.en:
The first probe stores one bit in the absolute mean brightness of each block.
It uses quantization index modulation [ 28 ] with step Δ \Delta .
We test G ∈ { 8 , 16 } G\in\{8,16\} and Δ ∈ { 8 , 16 } \Delta\in\{8,16\} .

The second probe stores one bit in the brightness difference between two neighboring blocks.
For bit 1, the left block must be brighter than the right block by at least T T ; for bit 0, darker by at least T T .
Pairs that already satisfy this are left unchanged.
We cap the change of any block at 2 ​ T 2T , so very large natural differences are not forced.
We use G = 16 G=16 , which gives 128 pairs and 4 repetitions per bit, and test T ∈ { 4 , 8 } T\in\{4,8\} .
At decoding, each pair gives one vote, clip ⁡ ( d / T , − 1 , 1 ) \mathrm{clip}(d/T,-1,1) , where d d is the measured difference.
blocks.zh:
第二个探测器存储在两个相邻地块的亮度相差的一点.
对于比特1,左块必须比右块更亮至少是T T;对于比特0,更暗至少是T T.
已经满足此条件的对等不变.
我们把任何区块的改变限制在2T2T, 所以非常大的自然差异不是强制的。
我们使用 G = 16 G = 16,每位给出128对和4次重复,测试 T → { 4 , 8 } T\in → 4,8\}.
在解码时,每对给出一票,剪接QQ(d / T,- 1, 1)\mathrm{clip}(d/T,-1,1),其中dd为所测量的差.

blocks.en:
We changed this decoder once.
Our first version summed the raw differences, and large natural differences hid the embedded votes: only 36 of 100 paintings were detected right after embedding with T = 8 T=8 .
The clipped vote fixes this without changing the false positive rate, and we use it throughout.
blocks.zh:
我们换了一次解码器
我们的第一个版本总结了原始差异,巨大的自然差异隐藏了嵌入式的票:在嵌入了T=8 T=8后,仅发现100幅画中的36幅.
选票剪断后,不改变错误的正率,就解决了这个问题,我们一直使用它。

blocks.en: VI-B Setup
blocks.zh: 设置

blocks.en:
We embed both probes in 100 paintings, the first 20 of each style.
We attack them with the same repainting, conventional, and regeneration settings as before.
We count an image as missed if the probe fails right after embedding.
So the detection rates below are over all 100 images.
blocks.zh:
我们把两个探测器嵌入了100幅画中,每种风格的前20幅.
我们用同样的再油漆、常规和再生环境来攻击它们。
如果探测器在嵌入后失败,我们算成错过了图像。
所以下面的探测率是超过所有100个图像.

blocks.en:
Both probes have no false positives in practice.
On the 500 clean paintings, five of the six configurations never fire.
QIM with G = 16 , Δ = 8 G=16,\Delta=8 fires once, which is in line with the designed rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
blocks.zh:
这两种探测器在实践中都没有虚假的阳性.
于五百清净相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
QIM与G=16,Q=8G=16,\Delta=8起火灾一次,这符合设计速度为10−3 10−3}.

blocks.en:
The probes trade visibility for robustness.
QIM with Δ = 8 \Delta=8 and pair with T = 4 T=4 reach a PSNR of about 37.5 dB, close to VINE (36.9 dB).
QIM with Δ = 16 \Delta=16 and pair with T = 8 T=8 reach only 31.5 dB and 30.6 dB.
Pair with T = 4 T=4 cannot be written into every painting: it is detected right after embedding in 60 of 100 paintings.
With T = 8 T=8 this rises to 96 of 100.
blocks.zh:
探测出贸易能见度 以达到强健性
QIM与QQ=8\Delta=8并配对为T=4T=4达到约37.5分贝的PSNR,接近VINE(36.9分贝).
有QQ=16\Delta=16,有T=8T=8对的QIM只达到31.5分贝和30.6分贝.
与 T = 4 T = 4的对等不能被写入每幅画中:在嵌入了100幅画中的60幅之后被检测出.
随着T=8T=8,这上升至100分之96.

blocks.en: VI-C Results
blocks.zh: VI-C 结果

blocks.en:
Relative brightness survives repainting.
Pair with T = 8 T=8 is detected in 83% of images after RP-2048/L6 (95% CI: 76–89%), where VINE is detected in 1.8%.
It is still detected in 77% of images at RP-512/L5, which draws only about 1,900 strokes.
It also survives all conventional distortions, with at least 91% detection.
blocks.zh:
相对亮度在再油漆中存活.
RP-2048/L6后83%的图像(95% CI:76-89%)中检测出与T=8的对等T=8,其中VINE检测为1.8%.
在77%的RP-512/L5图像中仍能检测到,这只抽取了约1 900下中风.
也活过所有的常规扭曲,至少91%的检测.

blocks.en:
Absolute brightness does not survive repainting.
All four QIM configurations are detected in at most 5% of images at L6 and finer levels.
They are robust to conventional distortions, with 66–98% detection under blur radius 8 and 71–97% under JPEG q5.
Their bit accuracy after repainting is often below chance.
For example, QIM with G = 8 , Δ = 16 G=8,\Delta=16 has a bit accuracy of 0.31 after RP-512/L6.
A bit accuracy far below 0.5 means that many bits flip in the same direction.
So repainting does not erase the block brightness.
It shifts it, and absolute codes cannot tolerate this shift.
The pair probe compares two neighboring blocks, so a shared shift cancels out.
blocks.zh:
绝对亮度无法活过再油漆。
所有四种QIM配置在L6和更细等的图像中被检测到最多5%.
其强力到常规扭曲,在模糊半径8下探测出66-98%,在JPEG q5下探测出71-97%。
他们再油漆后的位精度往往低于概率.
例如,G=8的QIM,Q=16 G=8,\Delta=16在RP-512/L6后有0.31位精度.
远低于0.5的一点精度意味着许多比特向同一方向翻转.
因此再油漆不会抹去块亮度.
它改变它,绝对代码不能容忍这种改变.
配对探测器比较了两个相邻的区块,因此共享的班次取消了.

blocks.en:
The probe also holds at a matched PSNR.
Pair with T = 4 T=4 has about the same PSNR as VINE.
It is detected in 29% of images after RP-2048/L6 (95% CI: 22–36%), compared with 1.8% for VINE.
blocks.zh:
探测器还在一个匹配的PSNR。
与 T = 4 T = 4 的对等与 VINE 的PSNR 大致相同.
它在RP-2048/L6后29%的图像中被检测出(95% CI:22–36%),而VINE的这一比例为1.8%.

blocks.en:
Robustness to repainting and to diffusion regeneration are separate properties.
The pair probe that survives repainting fails under diffusion regeneration: 6% after Regen-0.5.
VINE shows the opposite pattern: 1.8% after RP-2048/L6, but 47% after Regen-0.5.
Fig. 4 shows this for all methods.
No method we test survives both.
blocks.zh:
重新油漆和传播再生的能力是独立的特性。
在再油漆后存活下来的对子探测器在再扩散过程中失败: Regen -0.5之后的6%.
VINE显示了相反的模式:RP-2048/L6后为1.8%,而Regen-0.5后为47%.
图4显示了所有方法。
我们测试的方法都无法幸存

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Detection rate against embedding PSNR after (a) RP-2048/L6 and (b) Regen-0.5. Probes use 100 paintings, and embedding failures count as misses. Error bars: 95% bootstrap CIs.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4:在(a) RP-2048/L6和(b) Regen-0.5. 后嵌入PSNR的检测率。 出错栏:95%的靴子陷阱 CI.

blocks.en: VII Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 七. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Our results show that a watermark can be robust to one kind of re-rendering and fragile to another.
VINE resists diffusion regeneration but not repainting.
Our pair probe resists repainting but not diffusion regeneration.
Robustness to conventional distortions does not predict either one: TrustMark survives blur but not repainting, and RivaGAN the other way round.
Benchmarks that test only conventional distortions and generative regeneration [ 1 , 14 ] therefore miss a real attack.
We suggest adding non-generative re-rendering, such as stroke-based repainting, to these benchmarks.
A claim that a watermark is hard to remove should also be tested against repainting.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,一个水印可以强大到一种重新投放,而脆弱到另一种。
VINE抵抗扩散再生,但不会再油漆.
我们的对子探测器不会再喷漆,但不会再扩散。
对常规扭曲的强烈性并不会预测其中任何一个:信任马克活下来的模糊而不会再油漆,而丽瓦甘则相反.
因此,仅检验传统扭曲和再生的基准[1、14]没有真正受到攻击。
我们建议在这些基准中增加非基因再投放,如中风再投放等。
水印难以取出的说法,也应经过再油漆检验.

blocks.en:
Our probe suggests that a signal carried by relative brightness between regions survives repainting.
This is the level that strokes reproduce.
The probe pays for this with visibility: with T = 8 T=8 it is about 6 dB lower in PSNR than VINE.
It also fails under diffusion regeneration.
Combining such a signal with a learned watermark may cover both attacks.
We leave this to future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的探测器显示,各区域之间相对亮度所携带的信号在再油漆中存活下来。
这是打出繁殖的关卡。
探测器以能见度支付:用T=8 T=8,比VINE在PSNR中低了约6分贝.
在扩散再生过程中也失败了。
将这种信号同有学识的水印结合起来,可能涵盖两种攻击。
我们将此留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Our study has several limits. • We test one stroke-based renderer, Paint Transformer. Other renderers, such as Learning to Paint [ 2 ] , may behave differently. • Repainting changes the texture of a painting. The output has visible brush strokes, so it is a convincing copy, not an exact one. For uses that need an exact copy, this attack is less useful. • The repainted images have small dark spots along the right and bottom borders. They come from the black initial canvas of the official code, where no stroke covers it. They do not affect our conclusions, but a stronger attacker could easily remove them. • Canvas size 2048 for the three weaker watermarks uses 100 images, and fidelity is computed on the VINE images only. • We changed the pair decoder once after seeing the first results (Sec. VI-A ). • We do not test watermarks embedded during image generation, such as Tree-Ring [ 12 ] or Gaussian Shading [ 13 ] . • We only study paintings. On photographs, the repainted output would look like a painting, so our threat model does not apply.
blocks.zh: • 我们的研究有几种局限性。 我们测试一个中风变形器,涂料变形器 其他渲染器,如"学习绘画"[2],可能行为不同. • 重新油漆改变了一幅画的纹理。 输出有明显的笔划,所以是一个令人信服的拷贝,而不是精确的拷贝. • 对于需要准确副本的用途,这次攻击用处不大。 被再油漆的图像沿右下边框有小暗点. 它们来自官方代码的黑色初始画布,其中没有中风覆盖. 它们并不影响我们的结论,但一个更强大的攻击者可以轻易地清除它们. • 三个较弱水印的Canvas尺寸为2048,使用100个图像,忠诚度仅在VINE图像上计算。 在看到第一批结果后,我们更换了一对解码器(Sec.VI-A)。 我们不测试在图像生成过程中嵌入的水印,例如"树-亮"[12]或"高斯沙丁"[13]. 我们只研究画作 在照片上,再油漆的输出会看起来像一幅画,所以我们的威胁模型不适用.

blocks.en: We test one stroke-based renderer, Paint Transformer. Other renderers, such as Learning to Paint [ 2 ] , may behave differently.
blocks.zh: 我们测试一个中风变形器,涂料变形器 其他渲染器,例如"学习绘画"[2],可能行为不同.

blocks.en: Repainting changes the texture of a painting. The output has visible brush strokes, so it is a convincing copy, not an exact one. For uses that need an exact copy, this attack is less useful.
blocks.zh: 重新油漆会改变一幅画的纹理。 输出有明显的笔划,所以是一个令人信服的拷贝,而不是精确的拷贝. 对于需要准确副本的用途,这次攻击用处不大.

blocks.en: The repainted images have small dark spots along the right and bottom borders. They come from the black initial canvas of the official code, where no stroke covers it. They do not affect our conclusions, but a stronger attacker could easily remove them.
blocks.zh: 被再油漆的图像沿右下边框有小暗点. 它们来自官方代码的黑色初始画布,其中没有中风覆盖. 它们并不影响我们的结论,但一个更强大的攻击者可以轻易地清除它们.

blocks.en: Canvas size 2048 for the three weaker watermarks uses 100 images, and fidelity is computed on the VINE images only.
blocks.zh: 三个弱水印的Canvas尺寸为2048,使用100个图像,忠诚度仅在VINE图像上计算出.

blocks.en: We changed the pair decoder once after seeing the first results (Sec. VI-A ).
blocks.zh: 我们在看到第一批结果(第VI-A节)后,就换了对解码器。

blocks.en: We do not test watermarks embedded during image generation, such as Tree-Ring [ 12 ] or Gaussian Shading [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们不测试在图像生成过程中嵌入的水印,例如"树-Ring"[12]或"高斯沙丁"[13].

blocks.en: We only study paintings. On photographs, the repainted output would look like a painting, so our threat model does not apply.
blocks.zh: 我们只研究画作 在照片上,再油漆的输出会看起来像一幅画,所以我们的威胁模型不适用.

blocks.en:
This paper describes a way to remove watermarks from paintings.
The attack uses only a public pretrained model, and anyone can run it already.
We think it is better for watermark designers to know about it.
We follow the licenses of the data and models: WikiArt and the VINE weights are for non-commercial research only.
blocks.zh:
本文描述了从画作中去除水印的方法.
攻击只使用公共预训模型,任何人都可以已经运行了.
我们认为水印设计师最好知道这件事
我们遵循数据和模型的许可:维基百科和VINE权重只用于非商业研究。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en:
Repainting a painting with brush strokes removes VINE, which survives all conventional distortions we tested.
The attack needs no training and no generative model, and the output still looks like the painting.
At the same removal level, diffusion regeneration changes the painting about twice as much.
No watermark we tested resists both attacks, so we hope future benchmarks include stroke-based repainting.
blocks.zh:
用笔划来再油漆一幅画可以消除VINE,它能活过我们测试过的所有常规扭曲.
攻击不需要训练,也不需要基因模型,输出仍然像画作.
在相同的去除水平上,扩散再生会使画作改变约两倍.
我们测试过的任何水印都抵挡不了两次攻击,因此我们希望今后的基准包括中风再油漆。
